---
description: "Build the Tauri desktop app. Use after any desktop/ or desktop/src-tauri/ change."
name: "desktop"
agent: "agent"
---
Build the desktop application by running the Vite/Tauri production build:

```
cd desktop && npm run build
```

If the build fails, fix the errors in `desktop/` and re-run until it succeeds, then report the outcome.
